name: agent-boxes
description: A side bar for Claude Code: Claude, Codex and Antigravity usage meters, what each running agent is doing, the current task, and a recommended next step

brief.title: Now / Next summaries
brief.description: After each turn, ask a small model what is under way and what to do next (one short call per turn)

briefModel.title: Summary model
briefModel.description: Model alias or id for the Now / Next summaries

width.title: Side bar width
width.description: Columns the side bar asks for

background.title: Background
background.description: black paints the boxes with the terminal's black (matches most dark themes); dock keeps the side bar's own colour

python.title: Python command
python.description: Python 3.8+ command for the Codex and Antigravity boxes, a path (spaces are fine) or a command with arguments (py -3, 'C:/My Env/python.exe' -X utf8); empty tries python3, python, then py
